description: This file defines classes, structures, and enums related to UE scheduling, including requests for grants, allocation statuses, and the main class 'ue_cell_grid_allocator' which manages resource allocation for uplink and downlink grants in a cellular network scheduler.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Main class responsible for allocating PDCCH, UCI, PDSCH, and PUSCH resources for UE grants in a cellular network.

classes.name: dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder class for deferred setting of PDSCH parameters in downlink grants.

classes.name: ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder class for deferred setting of PUSCH parameters in uplink grants.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Allocates downlink grant resources for a new transmission request, returning a builder to set PDSCH parameters.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant (reTx)
methods.description: Allocates downlink grant resources for a HARQ retransmission.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Allocates uplink grant resources for a new transmission request, returning a builder to set PUSCH parameters.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant (reTx)
methods.description: Allocates uplink grant resources for a HARQ retransmission.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes resource allocations at the end of a slot, possibly resizing grants to utilize remaining RBs.
